annotations.summary: Checkout p99 latency 2.4s, burning the latency budget 6x
annotations.description: p99 on POST /api/checkout/pay drifted from 780ms to 2.4s over three hours, starting about 40 minutes before the earliest change in the window shipped. Error rate is normal and no deploy went out. A replay against the previous build reproduces the same p99, and the payments provider dashboard shows their own authorization latency up 900ms over the same period.
